item.title: Re : Stealing files from controls.
item.dc:creator: thecountofzero
item.description:
Why are you stealing and trying to use the inherited (child) control from within the super (parent) control?

It seems like an architectural issue to me. You shouldn't be referencing a control that will extend the current control from within that current control. From the perspective of the parent, the child doesn't exist. Only the child should know about the control from which it extends.

item.title: Re : Generated production files are empty!
item.dc:creator: tony
item.description:
That's what I'm finding so strange here. I've removed the absolute paths and steal finds the files just fine. At least a) it doesn't report a problem and b) I can see requests to my app server for the files that are returned properly.

Still, the contents of the included files just aren't there in the generated production.js file.

I'm at the point of tracing/debugging steal itself, but I can't find the place where the code is actually written to the generated file. Could someone point me to that spot? (Or, if you have an idea of where my problem lies, that'd be even better!)
